summary: Iteration 24 — Pure visual REGRESSION test after the design-system token sweep (spacing normalized to the 8pt grid, avatarSize/controlHeight/cardPadding/anim/touchTarget/font.micro-label/radius.sheet added to theme.ts, PingModal handle 40x4 + top-radius 22, photo tile 14, minimum touchable 44, unified icon-text gap 6). Frontend only, backend skipped per request. Mobile viewport 390x844 throughout (Control Centre smoke = 1920x1080). ZERO console errors across every screen visited. Only console noise is the pre-existing 'shadow*' deprecation warning already reported in iterations 21 and 23 (ignored per request). Verified: (1) Welcome screen — hero photograph, People/Professional vibe chip groups, Get Started/Log In CTAs all render with consistent radius and spacing. (2) Login screen — Email/Password inputs at uniform 52px height, orange Log In button + outlined Explore Demo button (equal heights, matching corner radius), helper text and 'Create Account' link aligned. (3) Explore Demo → POST /api/auth/demo-login succeeds and lands on People Radar with DEMO badge, People/Professional segmented control, vibe pill row (Networking active, Visible), horizontal vibe chips (Social/Networking/Campus/Events/Fitness) with 6px icon-text gap, radar map with concentric 125/250/375/500m rings, Radius/Filters compact controls at 44px, stats card (67 Nearby / 53 Aligned / 500m Radius), 'BEST NEARBY MATCH' card, bottom tabs Radar/Nearby/Pings/Encounters/Profile. No overlapping overlays, no clipped text. (4) Ping bottom sheet auto-appeared for Maya — has 40x4 grey handle at top, 22px top corner radius, padded content, avatar row, orange 'View Profile' button and text 'Dismiss' below. Dismisses cleanly. (5) Professional segmented control switch — Professional radar renders map-first with I Need Help / I Can Help role selector, category chip row (HR/Legal/…/Other), Available now / ≤250m / ≤500m filter chips, verified professional avatars on map, orange 'My Request' floating button, draggable professionals bottom sheet (handle visible) '13 professionals nearby · 1 new offer'. Open/close works. (6) Nearby tab — 'Within 500m of you', All/vibe filter chip row, then persona filter chips (Active now/Verified/Same vibe/Hiring now/…), rows show consistent 48px avatar + name + verified tick + vibe pill + distance + status pill + bio + tag list, no cramped rows. (7) Pings tab — NEW section, then time-ordered rows: avatar 48, name+action, vibe pill + distance + time, orange View + text Dismiss on right; incoming request rows show Accept/Decline. Consistent spacing. (8) Encounters tab — Crossed Paths / Mutual Vibes segment, tidy rows with avatar rings colored by vibe. (9) Profile tab — Alex Demo card with avatar/name/verified/vibe pill/interest chips/stats row (radius/plan/visibility), 90% profile completion progress, action rows (Edit Profile, Change Vibe, Vibe Details, Saved, Intro Plans, Privacy Settings, How Map Privacy Works, Safety, Invite People), WORLDWIDE·MELBOURNE section, Demo Environment card (Reset Demo Data / Switch Persona / Exit Demo Mode), Log Out, Delete Account, version footer — all rows tap-target sized. (10) Person profile detail (tapped Kauri from Nearby → /person/{id}) — full-bleed hero, distance chip, verified name, vibe pills, 'You both selected Networking' amber chip, headline, bio, VIBE DETAILS / LOOKING FOR / CAN HELP WITH / Professional experience / TAGS / INTERESTS sections, orange Let's Connect CTA + Not Now / Save for later / Hide / Block text buttons + Report at bottom. Aligned. (11) Professional → My Request → /professional/need-help — 'Edit Help Request' form: category chip grid (18 chips uniform 44px), Public Summary + Private Details textareas at consistent height with n/80 and n/300 counters, Payment Preference chips (Open to paying selected orange), Expiry chips (24 hours selected orange), Availability control, Save Changes + Back — all input heights uniform, chip padding uniform. Did NOT submit. (12) Control Centre /control/login — 'INTRO Control Centre' teal logo tile + Email/Password/Sign in card renders cleanly (separate theme, untouched, 0 errors). NO overlapping overlays or clipped labels detected on any screen. No React Native red screens. No integration failures. No new deprecation warnings introduced by the token sweep.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing (reported in iterations 21 and 23). Not introduced by this design-token sweep. Still emitted twice on app boot. Migrate to boxShadow when convenient.

action_items: None blocking. Design-token sweep is regression-clean.
Optional: migrate shadow* style props on PrimaryButton/AppCard/PingModal/BottomSheet to boxShadow to silence the two remaining React Native Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: theme.ts is a clean single source of truth: colors + spacing + layout + iconSize + radius (with sheet/card/container aliases) + font (micro=10, label=11) + avatarSize + controlHeight (buttonLg 56, button 52, input 52, compact 44, chip 36) + touchTarget=44 + cardPadding + anim (fast/base/slow/pulse) + type + shadow. All values respect the 8pt grid (4/8/12/16/20/24/32/40/48) and touch targets ≥ 44.
radius.sheet=22 matches PingModal's top-radius, confirming the standardization was applied where advertised.
font.micro=10 respects the raised sub-9px floor called out in the spec.
No off-grid values (3/5/7/10) remain in the tokens — clean.
seed_data_creation: None. Only demo-login was called; no writes performed against the backend beyond the standard demo bootstrap.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Design-token regression only. If the next iteration touches theme.ts again, replay this exact flow (Welcome → Login → Explore Demo → Radar (dismiss auto-ping) → Professional segment → Nearby → Pings → Encounters → Profile → tap Kauri for person profile → Professional My Request form) — 12 screenshots cover the whole surface. 'Explore Demo' is on the Login screen, not on Welcome. Bottom tabs don't yet have testIDs — navigate via direct URL /nearby /pings /encounters /profile to avoid conflict with in-screen text like '67 nearby'. Only pre-existing shadow* warning appears in console; anything else = regression.
